examples.zh: 晚上我想做土豆饭。
examples.en: I want to make a potato dish for dinner tonight.

examples.zh: 你家冰箱里还有土豆吗？
examples.en: Do you still have potatoes in your fridge?

examples.zh: 这家店的土豆做得很好吃。
examples.en: The potato dishes at this restaurant are very good.

note: 偶然 遇到 = run into by chance; 偶然 的 机会 = a chance opportunity.

examples.zh: 我在地铁上偶然遇到了老朋友。
examples.en: I ran into an old friend on the subway by chance.

examples.zh: 这不是偶然的，他每天都很努力。
examples.en: This is no accident; he works hard every day.

examples.zh: 我只是偶然听到这件事。
examples.en: I only happened to hear about this.

examples.zh: 两家医院明年要合并。
examples.en: The two hospitals will merge next year.

examples.zh: 请把这两个文件合并成一个。
examples.en: Please merge these two files into one.

examples.zh: 公司为什么要合并这两个部门？
examples.en: Why does the company want to merge these two departments?

meaning: to be in (a situation or stage); to be located in

senses.en: to be in (a situation or stage); to be located in

note: Usually followed by a state: 处在 …… 阶段 / 状态 / 困难 之中.

examples.zh: 他现在处在很难的情况中。
examples.en: He is in a very difficult situation right now.

examples.zh: 这个项目还处在开始的阶段。
examples.en: This project is still at the beginning stage.

examples.zh: 我们公司处在城市的中心。
examples.en: Our company is located in the center of the city.

meaning: person in charge, head (of a project or unit)

senses.en: person in charge, head (of a project or unit)

examples.zh: 请问，这里的负责人是谁？
examples.en: Excuse me, who is in charge here?

examples.zh: 我想找你们的负责人谈一下。
examples.en: I'd like to talk to the person in charge.

examples.zh: 他是这个项目的负责人。
examples.en: He is the person in charge of this project.

meaning: to be used for/in/on (a purpose or field)

senses.en: to be used for/in/on (a purpose or field)

note: 用于 + purpose: 用于 治疗 = used for treatment.

examples.zh: 这种药主要用于治疗感冒。
examples.en: This medicine is mainly used to treat colds.

examples.zh: 这些钱不能用于个人生活。
examples.en: This money can't be used for personal expenses.

examples.zh: 这台机器用于检查身体。
examples.en: This machine is used for medical checkups.

meaning: year (as a period: fiscal, annual); annual

senses.en: year (as a period: fiscal, annual); annual

note: Used in compounds: 年度 总结 (annual review), 年度 计划.

examples.zh: 我们下个月要写年度总结。
examples.en: We have to write the annual review next month.

examples.zh: 今年的年度计划已经定好了。
examples.en: This year's annual plan has been settled.

examples.zh: 他是今年的年度最好员工。
examples.en: He is this year's best employee.

meaning: to make out, tell, see (from looking)

senses.en: to make out, tell, see (from looking)

note: Often with 来: 看出来; negative 看不出.

examples.zh: 你看出他不高兴了吗？
examples.en: Could you tell he was unhappy?

examples.zh: 我看不出这两个有什么不同。
examples.en: I can't see any difference between these two.

examples.zh: 从他的脸色，我看出他病了。
examples.en: From his complexion I could tell he was sick.

meaning: master worker; polite address for a tradesperson or driver

senses.en: master worker; polite address for a tradesperson or driver

note: Common way to address a driver, cook or repairman: 师傅.

examples.zh: 师傅，请去机场，谢谢。
examples.en: Driver, to the airport, please. Thanks.

examples.zh: 修空调的师傅说下午能来。
examples.en: The repairman for the air conditioner says he can come this afternoon.

examples.zh: 这位师傅做的菜特别好吃。
examples.en: The dishes this chef makes are especially tasty.

examples.zh: 早饭我想吃两根香肠。
examples.en: I'd like two sausages for breakfast.

examples.zh: 这种香肠是在哪里买的？
examples.en: Where did you buy this kind of sausage?

examples.zh: 我不吃香肠，给我一个鸡蛋吧。
examples.en: I don't eat sausage; give me an egg instead.

meaning: measure word for sessions, graduating classes, terms

senses.en: measure word for sessions, graduating classes, terms

note: 第 + number + 届: 第十届 = the 10th session; 本届 = this session.

examples.zh: 他是上届的毕业生，比我大。
examples.en: He is from the previous graduating class, older than me.

examples.zh: 这是第十届国际会议。
examples.en: This is the tenth international conference.

examples.zh: 你是哪届的学生？
examples.en: Which graduating class are you from?

examples.zh: 这条河被工厂污染了。
examples.en: This river has been polluted by a factory.

examples.zh: 空气污染对身体不好。
examples.en: Air pollution is bad for your health.

examples.zh: 别把脏东西放进去，会污染食物的。
examples.en: Don't put dirty things in; it will contaminate the food.

examples.zh: 那位裁判的决定不公平。
examples.en: That referee's decision wasn't fair.

examples.zh: 谁来当今天比赛的裁判？
examples.en: Who will referee today's match?

examples.zh: 裁判说开始，比赛就开始了。
examples.en: The referee said go, and the match began.

examples.zh: 你想法很大胆，我喜欢。
examples.en: Your idea is very bold; I like it.

examples.zh: 想说就大胆地说吧。
examples.en: If you want to say it, go ahead and say it boldly.

examples.zh: 她真大胆，一个人去了国外。
examples.en: She is so brave; she went abroad alone.

meaning: rabbit (mostly in compounds like 兔子)

senses.en: rabbit (mostly in compounds like 兔子)

note: In speech usually 兔子; 兔 alone appears in compounds and the zodiac.

examples.zh: 今年是兔年，你属什么？
examples.en: This is the Year of the Rabbit; what's your zodiac sign?

examples.zh: 我女儿想养一只小兔。
examples.en: My daughter wants to keep a little rabbit.

examples.zh: 他属兔，今年三十六岁。
examples.en: He was born in the Year of the Rabbit and is 36 this year.

meaning: chief executive, president or chairman (of a company)

senses.en: chief executive, president or chairman (of a company)

examples.zh: 公司的总裁明天要来开会。
examples.en: The company president is coming to the meeting tomorrow.

examples.zh: 她刚当上了这家公司的总裁。
examples.en: She has just become president of this company.

examples.zh: 这封信请交给总裁。
examples.en: Please hand this letter to the president.

examples.zh: 你有剪刀吗？借我用一下。
examples.en: Do you have scissors? Let me borrow them.

examples.zh: 这把剪刀不太快了。
examples.en: These scissors aren't very sharp anymore.

examples.zh: 请用剪刀剪这张纸。
examples.en: Please cut this paper with scissors.

examples.zh: 她头发上戴着一朵红花。
examples.en: She is wearing a red flower in her hair.

examples.zh: 天上有几朵云。
examples.en: There are a few clouds in the sky.

examples.zh: 这朵花开得真漂亮。
examples.en: This flower has bloomed beautifully.

note: Often 信心十足 (full of confidence), 傻气十足.

examples.zh: 他对明天的比赛信心十足。
examples.en: He is full of confidence about tomorrow's match.

examples.zh: 这孩子十足是个小大人。
examples.en: This kid is a real little adult.

examples.zh: 她今天精神十足，看起来很开心。
examples.en: She is full of energy today and looks very happy.

note: 检验 = check against a standard; 检查 is a general check.

examples.zh: 这批产品要先检验才能卖。
examples.en: This batch of products must be inspected before it can be sold.

examples.zh: 试一试是检验想法的好办法。
examples.en: Trying it out is a good way to test an idea.

examples.zh: 医生让我去检验身体。
examples.en: The doctor told me to go get a checkup.
